name: comp-173
blurb: Compact on/off switch, smaller than the default.
description: Smaller toggle switch using shadcn's Switch primitive with custom sizing.
use_when: Constrained spaces like toolbars, lists, or compact controls where a smaller footprint helps.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces where a smaller target is harder to interact with.
a11y: Built on accessible Switch primitive. Smaller size may reduce touch target area.
